name: B1·1 Lead Capture Hub — form + missed-call + Justdial + link-clicks → one CRM (4 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Credentials → add **Google Sheets OAuth** (connect your Google account).
2. Create a spreadsheet with tab **Enquiries** (columns: Date, Type, Source, Item, Amount, Customer, Phone, FollowUp, Status). Copy its ID from the URL into every Sheets node (replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID).
3. Credentials → add **Telegram** (token from @BotFather). Set variable **TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID** (Settings → Variables).
4. Activate the workflow (top-right toggle). Copy each Webhook node's **Production URL**:
   • `lead-form` → paste as your website form's action / Webflow-Wix webhook.
   • `missed-call` → paste in your telephony panel (Exotel/Knowlarity/Twilio) as the missed-call webhook.
   • `click-log` → use as the link behind 'Chat on WhatsApp' buttons: it logs, then redirects to wa.me.
5. For Justdial: forward Justdial lead emails to a Gmail label, connect **Gmail credential**, set the label in the Gmail Trigger.

## 🔧 FIX
• Webhook 404 → workflow not Active, or using Test URL instead of Production.
• Sheets 403 → re-connect OAuth, share the sheet with the connected account.
• Telegram silent → send 'hi' to the bot once, check TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID.
